Done. Single-file landing page built at `D:\qbench-work\D-designonly-r2\index.html` (1,156 lines, tags balanced, no external JS — only Google Fonts + OG image).

## What I built

A **Google recommendation** page synthesizing all four requested styles:

| Style | How it's expressed |
|---|---|
| **Editorial Minimalism** | Warm paper base, generous "Space is Wealth" white space, editorial index-style product list with mono section numbers (`01 / The portfolio`) |
| **Modern Swiss** | 12-column grid, strict 8pt spacing rhythm, Major Third (1.25×) type scale, tight `-0.025em` headline tracking, monochrome ink + one accent system |
| **Liquid Glass** | Frosted `backdrop-blur` nav pill, the iconic glass **search box**, glass CTA buttons — over a soft four-color ambient field so the glass has something to refract |
| **Visible Grid** | A fixed 12-column overlay with column numbers + corner crop/registration marks, plus a **corner toggle** to switch it on/off (the signature interaction) |

**Authenticity:** real Google four-color wordmark, the real mission statement, real product names, and a footer disclaimer that it's a concept (not affiliated with Google LLC).

## Self-audit against the frameworks

**`design-audit` — 30s + LIFT:**
- ✅ Speed & OG — no heavy JS, custom OG tags present
- ✅ Work visibility — 10 products shown immediately in the index (nothing hidden behind hover)
- ✅ Typography — 2 families (Space Grotesk + Space Mono), clear hierarchy
- ✅ LIFT — one leverage point (hero headline + search), predictable→surprise flow, CTA in hero + nav + final section

**`design-psychology` — 3 brains:**
- ✅ Brain #1 (safety) — logo top-left, nav top-right, footer bottom; predictable layout
- ✅ Brain #2 (emotion) — MAYA interrupts: grid toggle, marquee ticker, hover row-expand, arrow rotate, ambient parallax
- ✅ Brain #3 (logic) — value props chunked to exactly **3**, stats to **3**

**`design-rules`:** Major Third scale, 8pt spacing, 60-30-10 (paper 60% / ink+surfaces 30%
